questions.q: In the absence of oxygen (anaerobic conditions), what is the primary end-product of glycolysis in human muscle cells?
questions.explain: During anaerobic glycolysis, pyruvate is converted to lactate to regenerate $\text{NAD}^+$, allowing glycolysis to continue producing ATP without oxygen.
